summary: Espinoza explicitly labels Netanyahu's Gaza war a genocide and positions himself against AIPAC, which he says controls both of his opponents. His pro-Palestine advocacy predates the 2026 race: in October 2024, he thanked the Fort Bend County Anti-Genocide/Pro-Palestine team for naming him to their recommended-candidate slate, citing his Palestine advocacy and anti-AIPAC stance. By June 2026, he urges voters to Vote Peace.
